nextAction: Build a simple, mobile-first website covering services, location, opening hours and a way to make contact.

recommendations.title: Establish a business website
recommendations.description: The business has no website on record, so customers searching online find only third-party directory entries that it does not control.
recommendations.suggestedAction: Build a simple, mobile-first website covering services, location, opening hours and a way to make contact.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Customers searching online can find accurate information published by the business itself rather than by a directory.

recommendations.title: Fix secure delivery
recommendations.description: The website's secure connection is missing or broken, so browsers warn visitors before they see any content.
recommendations.suggestedAction: Install a valid TLS certificate, enable automatic renewal, and redirect all traffic to HTTPS.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Visitors reach the site without a browser security warning.

recommendations.title: Add online appointment booking
recommendations.description: Customers cannot book online, so every appointment has to be arranged by telephone during working hours.
recommendations.suggestedAction: Add online booking that shows real availability and confirms automatically.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Customers can book outside working hours, and staff spend less time on the telephone.

recommendations.title: Give patients access to their own records
recommendations.description: Patients have no way to see their reports, prescriptions or visit history without contacting the practice.
recommendations.suggestedAction: Introduce a patient portal that publishes reports and history securely to the patient who owns them.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Patients retrieve their own reports instead of telephoning reception for them.

recommendations.title: Make the website usable on a phone
recommendations.description: The site declares no mobile viewport, so it will not lay out correctly on a phone screen.
recommendations.suggestedAction: Rebuild the site templates responsively, starting with the pages customers land on most.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Visitors arriving on a phone can read the site and act on it without pinching and scrolling.

recommendations.suggestedAction: Build a simple, mobile-first website covering services, location, opening hours and a way to make contact.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Customers searching online can find accurate information published by the business itself rather than by a directory.

recommendations.title: Fix secure delivery
recommendations.description: The website's secure connection is missing or broken, so browsers warn visitors before they see any content.
recommendations.suggestedAction: Install a valid TLS certificate, enable automatic renewal, and redirect all traffic to HTTPS.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Visitors reach the site without a browser security warning.

recommendations.title: Add online appointment booking
recommendations.description: Customers cannot book online, so every appointment has to be arranged by telephone during working hours.
recommendations.suggestedAction: Add online booking that shows real availability and confirms automatically.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Customers can book outside working hours, and staff spend less time on the telephone.

recommendations.title: Give patients access to their own records
recommendations.description: Patients have no way to see their reports, prescriptions or visit history without contacting the practice.
recommendations.suggestedAction: Introduce a patient portal that publishes reports and history securely to the patient who owns them.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Patients retrieve their own reports instead of telephoning reception for them.

recommendations.title: Make the website usable on a phone
recommendations.description: The site declares no mobile viewport, so it will not lay out correctly on a phone screen.
recommendations.suggestedAction: Rebuild the site templates responsively, starting with the pages customers land on most.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Visitors arriving on a phone can read the site and act on it without pinching and scrolling.
